title: The Heaviest Spoon in the Universe
lines: One teaspoon of this weighs more than every human on Earth. | Combined.
It's a neutron star: | what's left when a giant star dies and its core collapses.
More mass than our Sun, | crushed into a ball twenty kilometres wide: the size of a city.
Atoms are crushed so hard | that protons and electrons merge into neutrons, packed shoulder to shoulder.
So one teaspoon weighs about a billion tonnes. | All eight billion of us together weigh less.
And some of them spin over seven hundred times a second.
Drop a marshmallow on one, | and it hits with the energy of an atomic bomb.
What's the wildest space fact you know? | Tell me in the comments.
